title: Injection Sclerotherapy for Esophageal Variceal Bleeding
item_service_description: <p> Injection sclerotherapy is a technique involving insertion of a flexible fiberoptic endoscope into the esophagus, and the injection of a sclerosing agent or solution into the varicosities to control bleeding.</p>
indications_limitations: <p> This procedure is covered under Medicare.</p>
